projects.title: Web Scraping & Data Extraction
projects.shortDescription: An illustrative workflow for extracting structured information from public web pages and preparing it for analysis.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.description: This project demonstrates the process of programmatically extracting data from publicly accessible websites. The workflow handles HTML parsing, pagination, and data cleaning to produce a structured CSV dataset ready for analysis.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.description: Raw data is often locked inside complex web page structures, making it difficult to analyze efficiently without manual copy-pasting. Manual extraction is slow, error-prone, and does not scale.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.description: Implemented a Python script using BeautifulSoup to parse DOM elements, extract targeted information using CSS selectors, handle pagination, and organize the extracted records into a Pandas DataFrame. Output was saved to CSV format for downstream analysis.

sections.heading: Key Insights
sections.description: Automating data extraction saves hours of manual work, ensures data consistency, and enables repeatable data collection schedules. The structured output can be immediately plugged into analysis or BI tools.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.description: Understanding DOM traversal, handling HTTP requests and headers, respecting robots.txt, structuring unstructured data, and building resilient scrapers with error handling.

projects.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
projects.shortDescription: A sample analytical workflow demonstrating data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and visualization of dataset patterns.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.description: A comprehensive exploration of a synthetic dataset to identify underlying patterns, correlations, and anomalies before formal reporting. This workflow mirrors the initial phase of any real-world data analytics project.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.description: Raw datasets often contain missing values, outliers, and hidden trends that must be addressed before business decisions can be made. Skipping EDA leads to unreliable conclusions.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.description: Used Pandas for data cleaning, handling missing values, and aggregations. Applied Matplotlib and Seaborn for visualizing distributions, correlations, trends, and categorical relationships. Documented findings in a structured notebook.

sections.heading: Key Insights
sections.description: Identified key seasonal trends and outlier clusters that significantly impacted overall metric averages. Correlation analysis revealed strong relationships between specific variables that were not immediately obvious.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.description: Applying statistical summaries, handling missing data effectively, selecting appropriate chart types for different data, and communicating findings clearly.

projects.title: Financial Health Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: An illustrative financial dashboard concept presenting revenue, expenses, profitability, and financial trends.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.description: An interactive dashboard designed to monitor organizational financial health, consolidating revenue streams and expense tracking into a single unified view for stakeholders.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.description: Stakeholders need a real-time, consolidated view of financial performance rather than static, disconnected spreadsheet reports that require manual compilation every month.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.description: Transformed synthetic financial records using Power Query, developed DAX measures for KPIs like profit margin and YoY growth, and designed an intuitive dashboard layout with drill-down capabilities.

sections.heading: Key Insights
sections.description: Provides clear visibility into monthly profit margins and highlights expense categories exceeding budget thresholds. Enables faster month-end review and more confident forecasting.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.description: Data modeling best practices, DAX measure creation, dashboard UI design, and understanding financial KPIs.

projects.title: Human Resources Analytics Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: A comprehensive dashboard for tracking employee turnover, recruitment, and workforce distribution.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.description: This project illustrates how HR data can be visualized to monitor workforce metrics, retention rates, and departmental distributions in an interactive dashboard format.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.description: HR departments struggle to quickly analyze headcount trends and identify factors contributing to employee turnover without manually compiling data from multiple sources.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.description: Aggregated employee records, calculated retention metrics using DAX, and built interactive visualizations to filter by department, tenure, and demographic segments.

sections.heading: Key Insights
sections.description: Revealed specific departments with higher-than-average turnover, enabling targeted retention strategies. Recruitment funnel analysis showed bottlenecks at specific interview stages.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.description: Working with demographic data, calculating time-based metrics, designing HR-specific visuals, and applying data-driven thinking to people analytics.

projects.title: Sales Performance Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: A visual report tracking regional sales performance, pipeline conversion, and revenue targets.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.description: An illustrative Tableau dashboard that tracks sales rep performance against targets, regional revenue, and sales pipeline health across multiple dimensions.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.description: Sales managers lack visibility into regional performance and need a centralized tool to track pipeline conversions and identify underperforming segments quickly.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.description: Connected Tableau to a prepared dataset, created calculated fields for quota attainment, and designed interactive maps and bar charts with filter actions for drill-down exploration.

sections.heading: Key Insights
sections.description: Highlighted top-performing regions and identified bottlenecks in the sales conversion funnel, allowing targeted coaching and territory rebalancing.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.description: Connecting data sources, building interactive maps, designing executive-level summaries, and understanding sales KPIs.

projects.title: Tableau Business Intelligence Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: A conceptual BI dashboard demonstrating advanced data visualization, interactive filters, and executive reporting.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.description: A comprehensive Business Intelligence dashboard designed to give executives a high-level overview of enterprise performance metrics with drill-down capability into departments.

sections.heading: Problem Statement
sections.description: Executive teams need a quick, unified view of cross-departmental KPIs without digging into granular data tables or waiting for monthly reports.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.description: Designed a multi-pane Tableau dashboard using advanced filtering, parameter actions, and highly optimized visual hierarchies to support executive decision-making.

sections.heading: Key Insights
sections.description: Enables fast, data-driven decisions by providing immediate visual feedback on key performance indicators across departments and time periods.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.description: Advanced Tableau dashboard design, parameter actions, layout optimization, and understanding enterprise-level BI architecture.
